job_spec.purpose: s81-tail 2026-10-08: dsfd_ctrl_pc real-path diagnosis. The -lbc route's TT -556 / FF -487 were FAKE: io_ref_routed.sdc measured hbm_clk at 796 TT / 752 FF because the route SDC puts a data input delay (316.7 -clock vclk) on the clock port ckh[0], so the register clock pins carried a data arrival (fixed: io_ref_routed drops input delays on real-clock source ports, claude/s81-tail-20261008 13782fe21, deployed to the loop helpers). Real re-STA of that route under budget_rb1: TT -4.67 (k_tag[4] output to vclk_h, 4 hold buffers ~80 ps from the HM 50 / wrong-reference FF scene) / FF -7.54 (rq[0] input hold, 32 ps pin->flop). Fix: same RTL, current flow at TC, FF scene at the corrected routed reference, HM 25. 0 cycles.
